sbh3.2:3.1: sā khalveṣā vipaśyanā trimukhī ṣaḍvastuprabhedālambanā veditavyā |

sbh3.2:5.37: tatra dharmatāyuktyā tathābhūtatāṁ dharmāṇāṁ prasiddhadharmatāmacintyadharmatāmavasthitadharmatāmadhimucyate, na cintayati |
sbh3.2:7.3: aśubhādhipateyaṁ dharmaṁ śrutamudgṛhītamadhipatiṁ kṛtvā samāhitabhūmikena manaskāreṇaivamarthapratisaṁvedī bhavati |

sbh3.2:10.3: yadanena mṛtakuṇapaṁ svayaṁ vā dṛṣṭaṁ bhavati |

sbh3.2:10.5: hīnaṁ vā, madhyaṁ vā, praṇītaṁ vā, dahrasya vā, madhyasya vā, vṛddhasya vā |

sbh3.2:10.8: saptāham mṛtaṁ sañjātakṛmi ādhmātaṁ ca vimadrāmakaṁ vyādhmātakam ityadhimucyate |
sbh3.2:10.9: kākaiḥ kuralairgṛddhaiḥ śvabhiḥ śṛgālair khādyamānaṁ vikhāditakamityadhimucyate |
sbh3.2:10.11: diśodiśamaṅgapratyaṅgeṣu vikṣipteṣu viśleṣiteṣu samāṁseṣu nirmāṁseṣu kiñcicchiṣṭamāṁseṣu vikṣiptakamityadhimucyate |
sbh3.2:11.1: anyato vā hastāsthīnyanyataḥ pādāsthīnyanyato jānvasthīnyūrvasthīni, bāhvasthīni, prabāhvasthīni |
sbh3.2:11.5: yadā punaḥ sambaddham arikṣakaraṅkam aviśīrṇaṁ manasi karoti |
sbh3.2:11.11: api ca dve śaṅkalike dehaśaṅkalikā pratyaṅgaśaṅkalikā ca |
sbh3.2:11.12: tatra dehaśaṅkalikā śroṇīkaṭāhamupādāya pṛṣṭhīvaṁśo yāvadyatra śiraskapālaṁ pratiṣṭhitam |
sbh3.2:11.16: api ca dvau śaṅkalikāyā nimittagrāhau citrakṛtāyāḥ pāṣāṇakāṣṭhaśādakṛtāyā vā |
sbh3.2:12.1: sa khalveṣa bāhyāyā varṇanibhāyā upādāyarūpagatāyāstrividho vipariṇāmaḥ |
sbh3.2:12.5: tatra vikhāditakamupādāya yāvad vikṣiptakāt parakṛto vipariṇāmaḥ |
sbh3.2:12.6: tatrāsthikā vā śaṅkalikā vā ityayamubhayapakṣyo vipariṇāmaḥ |
sbh3.2:12.7: ya evaṁ yathābhūtaṁ prajānāti bahirdhā aśubhatāmākārata evaṁ bahirdhā aśubhatāyāḥ svalakṣaṇaṁ paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:13.2: yathā cādhyātmaṁ bahiḥ kāyasyāśubhā varṇanibhayā apariṇatā yāvad bahirdhā bahiḥ kāyasyāśubhā varṇanibhā vipariṇatā ādhyātmikayā aśubhayā varṇanibhā samānadharmatāṁ tulyadharmatāmadhimucyate |
sbh3.2:13.3: iyamapi me śubhā varṇanibhā evaṁ dharmiṇī iti |
sbh3.2:13.4: ye 'pi kecit sattvā anayā śubhayā varṇanibhayā samanvāgatāsteṣāmapi sāśubhāyāṁ evaṁ dharmiṇī tadyatheyaṁ bāhyā |
sbh3.2:14.4: tāṁ yathābhūtamaprajānann adhyātmaṁ vā bahirdhā vā śubhāyāṁ varṇanibhāyāṁ saṁrāgamutpādayāmi viparyāsa eva kṛṣṇapakṣasaṅgṛhītaḥ |
sbh3.2:14.7: yā punarasyāṁ śubhāyāṁ varṇanibhāyāṁ aśubhadharmatānugatā yathābhūtānupaśyanā śuklapakṣyā |
sbh3.2:14.8: eṣa dharmaḥ aduḥkhaḥ avighātaḥ yāvad atonidānā upāyāsā nirudhyante |
sbh3.2:14.9: tatra yo 'yaṁ kṛṣṇapakṣasamayo nādhivāsayitavyaḥ prahātavyo viśodhayitavyaḥ |
sbh3.2:15.3: yeyamadhyātmaṁ aśubhā varṇanibhā seyaṁ vartamānamadhvānamupādāya yā punariyaṁ bahirdhā aśubhā varṇanibhā iyamapi vartamāna tāmevādhvānamupādāya |
sbh3.2:15.6: saiṣā tāvadatītamadhvānamupādāya śubhā satī tadyathā me etarhi |
sbh3.2:15.8: evamānupūrvyā etarhi vartamānamupādāya aśubhā saṁvṛttā, sā me iyaṁ aśubhā varṇanibhā vartamānamadhvānamupādāya aśubhā satī |
sbh3.2:15.12: iti hyatītānāgatapratyutpanneṣvadhvasvayamapi me kāya evaṁbhāvī, evaṁbhūtaḥ, etāṁ ca dharmatāmanatīta ityevaṁ kālaṁ samanveṣate |
sbh3.2:16.3: nāstīti sa kaścidātmā vā sattvo vā adhyātmaṁ vā bahirdhā vopalabhyamānaḥ yaḥ śubho vā syādaśubho vā |
sbh3.2:16.4: api ca rūpamātrametat kaṇḍavaramātrametad yatreyaṁ saṁjñā samājñā prajñaptirvyavahāraḥ |
sbh3.2:16.9: tasyāsya mṛtasya kālagatasyānupūrveṇa vipariṇatā imā avasthāḥ prajñāyante |
sbh3.2:16.10: yaduta vinīlakamiti vā yāvadasthiśaṅkalikāyā vā ayamapi me kāyaḥ |
sbh3.2:16.13: yena hetunā, yena nidānena iyaṁ tāvatkālikī śubhā varṇanibhā prajñāyate |
sbh3.2:16.14: antaḥkāyaḥ punarnityaṁ nityakālamadhyātmaṁ ca bahirdhā cāśubhā evaṁ saṁvṛtiparamārthanidānataḥ |
sbh3.2:17.1: tasyaivaṁ bhavatīyamaśubhatā evamāsevitā bhāvitā bahulīkṛtā kāmarāgaprahāṇāya saṁvartate |
sbh3.2:17.5: aśubhā āsevitā bhāvitā bahulīkṛtā kāmarāgaprahāṇāya saṁvartata ityayaṁ tāvanme āptāgamaḥ |
sbh3.2:17.7: ahamasmi yathā yathā aśubhatāṁ bhāvayāmi, manasi karomi |
sbh3.2:18.2: maitryadhipateyaṁ dharmamadhipatiṁ kṛtvā hitasukhādhyāśayagatasya sarveṣu sukhopasaṁhārādhimokṣalakṣaṇā maitrītyetamarthapratisaṁvedyarthaṁ paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:19.2: sarva ete pakṣāḥ parasantānapatitatvād bāhyaṁ vastvityadhimucyate |
sbh3.2:19.3: mitrapakṣaṁ vā adhyātmamamitrodāsīnapakṣaṁ bahirdhā evaṁ ca vastuni maitrīṁ samanveṣate |
sbh3.2:20.2: ya ete trayaḥ pakṣāḥ aduḥkhā sukhatāḥ |
sbh3.2:20.7: ye punarete aduḥkhāsukhitāḥ pakṣāḥ sukhakāmāsteṣāṁ trividhā sukhakāmatā prajñāyate |
sbh3.2:20.11: evaṁ saprītikena niṣprītikena ca sukhena veditavyam |
sbh3.2:21.16: nātra kaścidyaḥ ākrośate vā, ākruśyate vā |
sbh3.2:21.21: śabdamātraṁ māṣamātrametadapi ca tathā saṁbhūto 'yaṁ kāyo rūpī audārikaścāturmahābhautiko yatra me sthitasyeme evaṁ rūpāḥ sparśāḥ krāmanti |
sbh3.2:21.24: anitya, ete 'pi sparśā ye te apakārakāste 'pyanityāḥ |
sbh3.2:21.26: sarva eva sattvā jātijarāvyādhimaraṇadharmāṇaste prakṛtyaiva duḥkhitāstanme pratirūpaṁ syāt |
sbh3.2:21.27: yadyahaṁ prakṛtiduḥkhiteṣu sattveṣu bhūyo duḥkhopasaṁhārameva kuryāṁ, na sukhopasaṁhāraṁ tadamitratraṁ mitrasya kuryādyad ete sattvā ātmanaivātmanaḥ kurvanti |
sbh3.2:22.3: yo 'nena dīrghasyādhvanotyayān mātā vā bhūt pitā vā, bhrātā vā, bhaginī vā, ācāryo vā, upādhyāyo vā, gururvā, gurusthānīyo veti |
sbh3.2:22.5: na cātra kasyacit pariniṣpattiḥ, mitrāmitrabhāvo, mitro 'pi tramapi ca kālāntareṇāmitro traṁ bhavati |
sbh3.2:23.2: yo me pāpakāriṣu sattveṣu vyāpādaḥ maraṇa eṣa dharma iti vistareṇa pūrvavat |
sbh3.2:23.3: yo vā punarayametarhyavyāpādaḥ amaraṇa eṣa dharma iti vistareṇa pūrvavat |
sbh3.2:24.2: ye tāvadatītamadhvānamupādāya sukhakāmāḥ sattvāḥ te atītāḥ, teṣāṁ kiṁ punaḥ sukhopasaṁhāraṁ kariṣyāmaḥ |
sbh3.2:24.4: yāvadanāgatādadhvano nityakālaṁ sukhino bhavantvityevaṁ maitryāḥ kālaṁ paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:25.2: nāsti kaścidātmā vā, sattvo vā ya eṣa sukhakāmo vā syāt |
sbh3.2:25.4: api tu skandhamātrametat saṁskāramātrakametad yatraiṣā saṁjñā saṁjñaptirvyavahāraḥ |
sbh3.2:25.5: te punaḥ saṁskārāḥ karmakleśahetukā ityevamapekṣāyuktyā maitrīm paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:25.6: prasiddhadharmatā khalveṣā acintyadharmatā yan maitrīvyāpādabhāvanā prahāṇāya saṁvartata ityevaṁ dharmatāyuktyā maitrīm paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:26.1: tatra kathamidaṁ pratyayatā pratītyasamutpādālambanā vipaśyanāprayuktārthaṁ paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:26.2: tadadhipateyaṁ dharmamadhimatiṁ kṛtvā teṣāṁ teṣāṁ dharmāṇāmutpādātte te dharmā utpadyante, teṣāṁ teṣāṁ dharmāṇāṁ nirodhātte te dharmā nirudhyante |
sbh3.2:26.3: nāstyatra dharmī kaścidīśvaraḥ, kartā, sraṣṭā, nirmātā dharmāṇāṁ, na prakṛtirna puruṣāntaraṁ, pravarttako dharmāṇāmityevamarthapratisaṁvedī arthaṁ paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:26.9: avidyā yattatpūrvānte ajñānamiti vistareṇa yathā pratītyasamutpādavibhaṅge evaṁ svalakṣaṇaṁ paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:26.11: evaṁ pratītyasamutpannāḥ saṁskārāḥ sarva ete abhūtvā bhāvād, bhūtvā ca prativigamātpūrvāparyeṇānityā jātijarāvyādhimaraṇadharmakatvāt |
sbh3.2:26.15: yo ya eṣvanityeṣu duḥkhaśūnyānātmakeṣu saṁskāreṣu yathābhūtaṁ pratisammohaḥ |
sbh3.2:26.23: yaḥ karttā vā pratisaṁvedako vā syānnānyatra dharmasaṁketāt |
sbh3.2:26.24: teṣvevāvidyāpratyayeṣu saṁskāreṣu yāvajjātipratyaye jarāmaraṇe saṁjñā prajñaptirvyavahāraḥ kārako vedaka ityevaṁ nāmā, evaṁ jātya, evaṁ gotra, evamāhāra, evaṁ sukhaduḥkhapratisaṁvedī, evaṁ dīrghāyurevaṁcirasthitika, evamāyuḥ paryanta iti |
sbh3.2:26.29: viṣayopabhogaphalaṁ yo yā iṣṭāniṣṭakarmādhipateyā ṣaṭsparśasaṁbhavā vedanā |
sbh3.2:26.30: tatrākṣepako heturdvividhe phale sammohāsammohapūrvakāśca puṇyāpuṇyāniṁjyāḥ, saṁskāraparigṛhītaṁ ca |
sbh3.2:26.31: punarbhavavijñānāṁkuraprādurbhāvāya tadbījaṁ, vijñānaparigṛhītaṁ paunarbhavikanāmarūpabījaṁ ṣaḍāyatanabījaṁ sparśavedanābījamiti |
sbh3.2:26.35: yatpunaravidyāsaṁsparśajāṁ vedanāṁ vedayamānastadālambanayā tṛṣṇayā paunarbhavikīṁ tṛṣṇāmutpādayati |
sbh3.2:26.38: yadbalena yatsāṁmukhyena tatkarma vipākadāne samarthaṁ bhavatyayamabhinirvṛttihetuḥ |
sbh3.2:26.39: imaṁ ca dvividhaṁ hetumadhipatiṁ kṛtvā evamasya trividhaḥ duḥkhatānupakṣasya kevalasyāsya duḥkhaskandhasya samudayo bhavatīti |
sbh3.2:26.44: prasiddhadharmatāpyeṣa teṣeti evaṁ kāryakāraṇayuktimupapattisādhanayuktiṁ dharmatāyuktiñca paryeṣate ||
sbh3.2:27.11: iti yaḥ piṇḍasaṁjñino dhātunānātvaṁ ajānānasyānena kāyena nānādhātukena unnatirmanyanā maraṇa eṣa dharmaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣyaḥ viparyayācchuklapakṣya ityevaṁ pakṣaṁ paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:27.14: tadyathā tṛṇaṁ vāpratītya, kāṣṭhamvā cākāśaṁ parivāritamagāra iti saṁkhyāṁ gacchatyevameva ṣaḍdhātūnupādāya |
sbh3.2:27.16: tvaṅmānsamāṁsa śoṇitaṁ cākāśe parivārite saṁjñā prajñaptirvyavahāro bhavati |
sbh3.2:27.20: āptāgamopyeṣa pratyātmajñānamanumānikopyeṣa vidhiḥ prasiddhadharmatā acintyadharmatetyevaṁ kāryakāraṇayuktimupapattisādhanayuktiṁ dharmatāyuktiṁ ca paryeṣate ||
sbh3.2:28.9: amī dīrghā āśvāsapraśvāsā, amī hrasvā imānsarvakāyena pratisaṁvedayāmi |
sbh3.2:28.13: āśvāsapraśvāsapravṛddhipratisambaddhaṁ ca || jīvitendriyamayaṁ ca kāyaḥ savijñānaka ityanityā āśvāsapraśvāsā mahāśravaṇetyevaṁ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṁ paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:28.14: evamāśvāsapraśvāseṣvanupasthitasmṛteḥ yo vitarkakṛtaḥ saṁkṣobhaścetasaḥ maraṇadharma eṣa dharmaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣyaḥ |
sbh3.2:28.17: atītānāgatapratyutpanneṣvadhvasvāśvāsapraśvāsapratibaddhaḥ kāyaḥ kāyacittaḥ pratibaddhāścāśvāsapraśvāsā ityevaṁ kālaṁ paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:28.18: nānyatra kaścidya āśvasiti praśvasiti vā asya caite āśvāsapraśvāsāḥ |
sbh3.2:28.19: api tu hetusamutpanneṣu, pratītyasamutpanneṣu saṁskāreṣviyaṁ saṁjñā |
sbh3.2:29.1: evaṁ caritaviśodhanenālambanena ṣaḍvastūni paryeṣya, adhyātmaṁ cittaṁ punaḥ punaḥ śamayataḥ yan, punaḥ punaretadeva yathāparyeṣitaṁ |
sbh3.2:29.4: vipaśyanāṁ niśritya śamatho vaipulyatāṁ vipulatāṁ gacchati |
sbh3.2:29.5: kauśalyālambane ca | kleśaviśodhane ca yā vipaśyanā |
sbh3.2:30.2: prayogastadviparyayeṇa ca navavidhaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣasaṁgṛhīto yoginā veditavyaḥ |
sbh3.2:30.4: aśithilaprayogatā | kālaprayogatā | upalakṣaṇaprayogatā | asaṁtuṣṭaprayogatā | avidhuraprayogatā | samyakprayogatā ca |
sbh3.2:30.5: anayā navavidhayā śuklapakṣasaṁgṛhītayā tvaritatvaritaṁ cittaṁ samādhīyate |
sbh3.2:30.7: yāvatī cānena bhūmirgantavyā bhavatyanuprāptavyā tāṁ laghu laghvevāgantā bhavatyadhandhāyamānaḥ |
sbh3.2:30.10: yāvatī cānena bhūmirgantavyā bhavatyanuprāptavyā | tatra dhandhāyate gamanāya |
sbh3.2:30.13: dveṣacarito maitryāṁ, yāvadvitarkacarita ānāpānasmṛtau, samabhāgacaritaḥ mandarajaskaḥ punaḥ yatrālambane priyārohatā bhavati |
sbh3.2:30.16: abhyāso 'nena kṛto bhavati yo antataḥ parītto 'pi na sarveṇa sarvamādikarmika eva bhavati |

sbh3.2:30.19: yenāsya tat ca cittaṁ samādhīyate | iyamabhyastaprayogatā |
sbh3.2:30.23: glānopasthānārthamvā, sāmīcīkarmaṇo vā anyasyaivaṁbhāgīyasyetikaraṇaṁ yasyārthāya sa tannimnena cetasā tatpravaṇena tatprāstāreṇa bhāreṇa ca sarvaṁ karoti |
sbh3.2:30.24: laghulaghveva ca kṛtvā, pariprāpya, punareva prayujyate |

sbh3.2:30.30: ahirvā me māṁ daśet | vṛściko vā śatapadī vā | manuṣyādapi me bhayam ityetāni sthānāni nityakālasya na karotyapramattaśca viharatyevaṁ ca punarapramatto viharati |

sbh3.2:31.3: śamathaṁ ca jānāti | śamathanimittaṁ ca | śamathakālañca |
sbh3.2:31.4: vipaśyanāṁ vipaśyanānimittaṁ vipaśyanākālaṁ, pragrahaṁ pragrahanimittaṁ, pragrahakālaṁ |
sbh3.2:31.7: nirnimittañca taccittaṁ tatra bhavati, nirvikalpaṁ, śānta praśāntaṁ, śamathasthitaṁ, niṣkevalaṁ, tenocyate śamatha iti |
sbh3.2:31.10: yenālambanena taccittaṁ śamayati, śamathaparibhāvite cetasi uttaratra śamathasya pāriśuddhaye |
sbh3.2:31.12: śamathakālaḥ katamaḥ | āha | uddhate citte ūrdhvamvābhiśaṁkini śamathasya kālo bhāvanāyai |
sbh3.2:31.13: tathā vipaśyanāparibhāvite citte iti karaṇīyavyākṣepopahate śamathakālo bhāvanāyai |
sbh3.2:32.2: tatrālambananimittaṁ vipaśyanānimittaṁ śamathapakṣyaṁ jñeyavastusabhāgaṁ pratibimbam ālambananimittaṁ |
sbh3.2:32.4: tatra nidānanimittaṁ vipaśyanāparibhāvite cetasi uttaratra vipaśyanāpariśuddhaye cetaḥśamathabimbayogaḥ |
sbh3.2:32.5: tatra vipaśyanākālaḥ śamathaparibhāvite cetasi ādita eva cājñeyavastuyathābhūtāvabodhāya vipaśyanāyāḥ kālo bhāvanāyai |
sbh3.2:32.8: tatra pragrahanimittaṁ yena ca prasadanīyenālambanena nimittena cittaṁ pragṛhṇāti |
sbh3.2:32.9: yasya vīryārambhaḥ tadānulomikastatra pragrahakālaḥ līnaṁ cittaṁ līnatvābhiśaṁkini pragrahasya kālo bhāvanāyai |
sbh3.2:32.16: tatropekṣākālaḥ śamathavipaśyanāpakṣālayau lauddhatyavinirmukte cetasi upekṣāyāḥ kālo bhāvanāyai |
sbh3.2:33.2: tānyeva nimittāni sugṛhītāni bhavanti | susaṁlakṣitāni yeṣāṁ sūdgṛhītatvāt |
sbh3.2:33.6: asaṁtuṣṭo bhavati kuśalairekuśalair dharmaiḥ | aprativā bhāṇiṇī ca |
sbh3.2:33.7: prahāsairuttaraṁ praṇītataraṁ sthānamabhiprārthayamāno rupī bahulaṁ viharatīti |
sbh3.2:33.8: nālpamātrakeṇāvaramātrakeṇāntarā viṣādamāpadyate | atyuttare karaṇīye | iyam asaṁtuṣṭaprayogatā |
sbh3.2:33.11: na ca śiśumudāravarṇaṁ raṁjanīyaṁ mātṛgrāmaṁ dṛṣṭvā nimittagrāhī bhavatyanuvyaṁjanagrāhī, bhojane ca samakārī bhavati |
sbh3.2:33.15: anukūlā ete dharmāścittaikāgratāyāḥ | avidūrā, na ca cittakṣepāya saṁvarttante |
sbh3.2:33.16: tena bahirdhā vyāsaṁgāya, nādhyātmacittākarmaṇyatāyai | iyam ucyate avidhuraprayogatā |
sbh3.2:34.3: sa cedaśubhāprayukto bhavati aśubhāṁ cāśubhākārair manasikaroti | nimittamātrānusāriṇyā vipaśyanayā |
sbh3.2:34.5: vibhāvanā punaḥ pañcavidhā — adhyātmacittābhisaṁkṣepataḥ | asmṛtyamanasikārataḥ | tadanyamanasikārataḥ | pratipakṣamanasikārataḥ | ānimittadhātumanasikārataśca |
sbh3.2:34.6: tatra navākāracittasthityā vipaśyanā pūrvaṁgamayā adhyātmaṁ cittābhisaṁkṣepataḥ |
sbh3.2:34.11: sarvanimittānām amanasikārād ānimittasya ca dhātor manasikārād ānimittadhātumanasikārataḥ |
sbh3.2:34.12: api ca | vyāpya tadālambanaṁ vibhāvanālakṣaṇaṁ vyavasthāpitamasmiṁstvarthe adhyātmaṁ nimittābhisaṁkṣepataḥ | asmṛtyamanasikārataścābhipretā |
sbh3.2:34.13: tatrādikarmikeṇa tatprathamakalpikakarmikeṇa ādita eva cittaṁ na kvacid ālambane upanibandhitavyaṁ | aśubhāyāmvā, tadasminvā, nānyatra vikṣepāyaiva |
sbh3.2:34.14: kaccinme cittaṁ nirnimittaṁ, nirvikalpaṁ śāntaṁ, praśāntam avicalam avikampyamanutsukaṁ, nirvyāpāram adhyātmam abhiramata iti |
sbh3.2:34.15: tathā prayukta utpannotpanneṣu sarvabāhyanimitteṣu asmṛtyamanasikāraṁ karoti | iyam asyāsmṛtyamanasikāreṇālambanavibhāvanā |
sbh3.2:35.1: sa tatra yogaṁ kurvan pratigṛhṇāti, sa nirnimitte cālambane savikalpamaśubhādike carati |
sbh3.2:35.2: kathaṁ ca punaścarati | nimittamātrānusāriṇyā vipaśyanayā paryeṣaṇāpratyavekṣaṇānucāriṇyā |
sbh3.2:35.4: punareva vipaśyanānimittaṁ | pratyudāvartya tadevālambanaṁ śamathākāreṇa manasi karoti |
sbh3.2:35.5: tena tadālambanaṁ tasminsamaye muktaṁ bhavati, nodgṛhītaṁ |
sbh3.2:35.7: yasmānna nimittīkaroti | na vikalpayati | tasmānnodgṛhītam evam adhyātmam abhisaṁkṣepataḥ | ālambanaṁ vibhāvayati |
sbh3.2:35.8: tatra vipaśyanānimittam udgṛhītavataḥ | punarjñeyavastunimittālambanaṁ sa cedayam ekāṁśenālambanam adhimucyate |
sbh3.2:35.9: na punaḥ punarvibhāvayet | nāsyādhimokṣa uttarottaraḥ | pariśuddhaḥ, paryavadātaḥ |
sbh3.2:35.11: yataśca punaḥ punaradhimucyate | punaḥ punarvibhāvayati | tatosyottarottarodhimokṣaḥ | pariśuddhataraḥ, pariśuddhatamaḥ pravartate | yāvaj jñeyavastupratyakṣopagamāya |
sbh3.2:35.12: tadyathā citrakaraścitrakarāntevāsī vā tatprathamaścitrakarmaṇi prayuktaḥ syāt |
sbh3.2:35.13: sa ācāryasyāntikācchikṣāpūrvagamaṁ rūpakam ādāya dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā pratirūpakaṁ karoti |
sbh3.2:35.14: kṛtvā kṛtvā vibhāvayati, vināśayati | punareva ca karoti |
sbh3.2:35.15: yathā yathā bhaṅktyā bhaṅktyā karoti | tathā tathāsyottaraṁ rūpakaṁ pariśuddhataraṁ paryavadātataraṁ khyāti |
sbh3.2:35.16: evaṁ hi samyakprayuktaḥ kālāntareṇācāryasamatāṁ gacchati | tatprativiśiṣṭatāmvā |
sbh3.2:35.17: sacetpunarabhaṅktvā tadrūpakaṁ tasyaivopariṣṭāt paunaḥpunyena kuryāt | na janvandhasya tadrūpakapariśuddhiṁ nigacchet — evam ihāpi nayo veditavyaḥ |
sbh3.2:35.18: tatra yāvadālambanam adhimucyate | tāvadvibhāvayati | na tvavaśyaṁ yāvadvibhāvayati | tāvadadhimucyate |
sbh3.2:35.20: parīttaṁ punarvibhāvayitvā bhāvya kadācitparīttamevādhimucyate | kadācinmahadgatam eva | pramāṇameva mahadgate | pramāṇe veditavyaṁ |
sbh3.2:35.21: tatra rūpiṇāṁ dharmāṇāṁ yannimittaṁ pratibimbaṁ, pratibhāsaṁ — tadaudārikaṁ nirmāṇasadṛśam — arūpiṇāmvā punardharmāṇāṁ nāmasaṁketapūrvakaṁ yathānubhāvādhipateyaṁ | pratibhāsam iyam ucyate |
sbh3.2:35.23: saiṣā navavidhā śuklapakṣyā śamathavipaśyanānulomā prayogatā veditavyā |
sbh3.2:35.25: sa eṣa kṛṣṇaśuklapakṣavyavasthānenāṣṭādaśavidhaprayogo bhavati iyam ucyate ekāgratā ||
sbh3.2:36.2: āha | caturbhiḥ kāraṇair evaṁ samyakprayukto yogī āvaraṇe svaṁ cittaṁ pariśodhayati |
sbh3.2:36.5: āha | catvāryāvaraṇāni | paritamanā, nivaraṇaṁ, vitarkaḥ | ātmasaṁpragrahaśceti |
sbh3.2:36.6: tatra paritamanā yā naiṣkramyaprāvivekyaprayuktasya kliṣṭā utkaṇṭhā, aratiḥ | spṛhaṇā, daurmanasyam upāyāsaḥ |
sbh3.2:36.9: tatrātmasaṁpragraho yad aṇumātrekeṇāvaramātrakeṇa jñānadarśanasparśamātrakeṇātmānaṁ saṁpragṛhṇāti | ahamasmi lābhī, anye ca na tatheti |
sbh3.2:37.2: tadyathā pūrvakarmādhipatyā, vyādhiparikleśādvā āśrayadaurbalyaṁ | atiprayogaḥ | ardhaprayogaḥ | ādiprayogaḥ | kleśapracuratā | vivekānabhyāsaśca |
sbh3.2:37.3: nivaraṇasya, vitarkāṇām ātmasaṁpragrahasya — nivaraṇasthānīye, avitarkasthānīye, svātmasaṁpragrahasthānīyeṣu dharmeṣv ayoniśomanasikāro bahulīkāro nivaraṇavitarkasaṁpragrahāṇāṁ nidānaṁ |
sbh3.2:37.4: yad aśubhatām amanasi kṛtya śubhatāṁ manasikarotyayam atrāyoniśaḥ |
sbh3.2:37.5: evaṁ maitrīṁ manasikṛtya, prahāya naimittikīm ālokasaṁjñāṁ manasikṛtyāndhakāranimittaṁ śamathamamanasikṛtya, jñātijānapadāmaravitarkaṁ paurāṇakrīḍitahasitarasitaparicāritaṁ |
sbh3.2:37.6: iyaṁ daṁ pratyayatā pratītyasamutpādam amanasikṛtya, traiyadhvikeṣv aham iti vā, mameti vā, ayogavihitāṁ saṁjñāṁ manasi karotyayam atrāyoniśastaśaḥ |
sbh3.2:37.8: asminnāvaraṇe sati saṁvidyamāne caturvidhe 'pyanadhigataṁ nādhigatāt parihīyate |
sbh3.2:37.9: yogaprayogād bhraśyate | saṁkliṣṭavihārī ca bhavati, duḥkhavihārī ca bhavatyātmā caitam avavadati | parataścāvavādaṁ labhate |
sbh3.2:37.10: kāyasya ca bhedāt paraṁ maraṇād apāyeṣūpapadyate | ayam atrādīnavaḥ |
sbh3.2:37.13: anusmṛtimanasikāreṇāyaṁ cittaṁ saṁharṣayitvā saṁharṣya utpannāṁ paritamanāṁ prativinodayati, anutpannāṁ ca notpādayati |
sbh3.2:37.14: tatra yacca kāyadaurbalyaṁ, yaścāpratiyogo, yaścādiprayogaḥ | tatra vīryasamatā pratiṣedhaḥ |
sbh3.2:37.15: pratipannaḥ yo 'rdhaprayogaḥ | tatra śuśrūṣā, paripṛcchā pratipakṣaḥ |
sbh3.2:37.18: pūrvaṁ me mayāvivekābhyāso na kṛto, yena me etarhi vivekaprayuktasya paritamanā utpadyate |
sbh3.2:37.19: sa cedetarhi na kariṣyāmyabhyāsaṁ evamāyatiḥ punarbhava evaṁrūpo bhaviṣyati |
sbh3.2:37.20: pratisaṁkhyāya mayā aratis tyaktavyā | ratiḥ karaṇīyetyevamiṣṭānāṁ nivaraṇādīnām ayoniśomanasikāraviparyayeṇa yoniśomanasikārabhāvanā pratipakṣo veditavyaḥ |
sbh3.2:37.21: tatra svabhāvaṁ parijñāya āvaraṇataḥ, saṁkleśataḥ, tāvac chamathabāhulyaṁ | sā khalveṣā vipaśyanā jñeyā kṛṣṇapakṣataḥ | parivarjanīyam etad iti |
sbh3.2:37.23: aparivarjanācca punarasya parivarjanīyasya ko doṣa ityata ādīnavaṁ paryeṣate |
sbh3.2:37.24: parivarjitasya cāyatyāṁ kathamanutpādo bhavatītyataḥ pratipakṣaṁ bhāvayatyevamanenāvaraṇebhyaścittaṁ pariśodhitaṁ bhavati |
sbh3.2:38.1: sa tatra yāvad deśanābāhulyaṁ vipaśyanānulomikaṁ tāvad vipaśyanābāhulyaṁ, yāvad vipaśyanābāhulyaṁ nānyādanantā veditavyā |
sbh3.2:38.2: yaduta ebhireva tribhirmukhaiḥ ṣaṇṇāṁ vastūnām ekaikaśyā syā anantākārapraveśanayena,
sbh3.2:38.3: yathā ca yathā vipaśyanā samyakprayuktasya pṛthuvṛddhivaipulyatāṁ vipulatāṁ gacchatyabhyāsapāriśuddhibalam adhipatiṁ kṛtvā, tathā tathā, śamathapakṣasyāpi kāyacittapraśrabdhijanakasya pṛthuvṛddhivaipulyatā vipulatā veditavyā |
sbh3.2:38.4: tasya yathā yathā kāyaḥ praśrabhyate, cittaṁ ca, tathā tathālambanacittaikāgratāyāśca yadutāśrayaṁ vivardhayate |
sbh3.2:38.5: yathā cittaikāgratā vivardhate tathā tathā kāyaḥ praśrabhyate, cittaṁ ca,
sbh3.2:38.6: ityetau dvau dharmāv anyonyaṁ nirvṛtāv anyonyaṁ pratibaddhau — yaduta cittaikāgratā, pratyakṣajñānotpattiḥ |
sbh3.2:38.7: tatra kiyatā aśubhā pratilabdhā bhavati | kiyatā yāvad ānāpānasmṛtiḥ pratilabdhā bhavatīti | peyālaṁ |
sbh3.2:38.8: ataścāsya yoginaḥ aśubhāprayogasyāsevanānvayāt bhāvanānvayād bahulīkārānvayāc carato vā, viharato vā, viṣayasaṁmukhībhāve api nimittapratyavekṣaṇayāpi prakṛtyaivānabhisaṁskāreṇa bahutarāśubhatāsaṁprakhyānaṁ |
sbh3.2:38.9: yathāpi tatsubhāvitatvādaśubhāyāḥ kāmarāgasthānīyeṣu dharmeṣu cittaṁ na praskandati | na prasīdati | nādhimucyate | upekṣā saṁtiṣṭhate | nirvitpratikūlatā veditavyā |
sbh3.2:38.10: yoginānuprāptaṁ me, aśubhā prāptaṁ me, bhāvanāphalam iyatā aśubhā pratilabdhā bhavati | viparyayeṇa apratilabdhā veditavyā |
sbh3.2:38.11: yathā aśubhā evaṁ maitrī, idaṁpratyayatāpratītyasamutpādaḥ | dhātuprabhedaḥ | ānāpānasmṛtiśca veditavyā |
sbh3.2:38.12: tatrāyaṁ viśeṣaḥ — bahutaraṁ maitracittatā khyāti | na pratighanimittaṁ | vyāpādasthānīyeṣu dharmeṣu cittaṁ na praskandatīti vistaraḥ |
sbh3.2:38.13: bahutaram anityatā, duḥkhatā, nairātmyaṁ khyāti, na nityasukhasattvāya — dṛṣṭisahagataṁ sammohanimittaṁ mohaparyavasthānīyeṣu dharmeṣu cittaṁ na praskandatīti vistaraḥ |
sbh3.2:38.14: bahutaraṁ nānādhātukatā tadekadhātukatā kāyacittaprabhedasaṁjñā khyāti | na tveva cittasaṁjñā, mānaparyavasthānīyeṣu dharmeṣu cittaṁ na praskandatīti vistaraḥ |
sbh3.2:38.15: bahutarā adhyātmamupaśamasaṁjñā | śamathasaṁjñā | khyāti | na tveva prapañcasaṁjñā vitarkaparyavasthānīyeṣu dharmeṣu cittaṁ na praskandatīti vistaraḥ |
sbh3.2:39.1: tatra niyatāntaṁ śamathaśca vipaśyanā cobhe mitrībhūte samayugaṁ varttete |
sbh3.2:39.3: āha | yo lābhī bhavati navākārāyāṁ cittasthitau navamasyākārasya — yaduta samāhitatāyāḥ |
sbh3.2:39.4: sa ca taṁ pariniṣpannaṁ samādhiṁ niśritya adhiprajñaṁ dharmavipaśyanāyāṁ prayujyate |
sbh3.2:39.5: tasya tasminsamaye dharmān vipaśyataḥ | svarasavāhana eva mārgo bhavatyanābhogavāhanaḥ |
sbh3.2:39.6: anabhisaṁskāreṇa vipaśyanā pariśuddhā, paryavadātā, śamathānuyogatāyāṁ kalpitā parigṛhītā pravarttate |
sbh3.2:39.7: yathaiva śamatham āsate tenocyate śamathaścāsya vipaśyanā cobhe mitrībhūte samayugaṁ varttete |
sbh3.2:40.3: arthatastu lakṣaṇaiḥ pacchaiḥ pakṣaiḥ kālaiśca saha yuktibhiḥ ||
sbh3.2:40.5: anurūpas tathābhyāsa āśaithilyād viparyayaḥ kālopalakṣaṇā tuṣṭiravaidhuryaṁ prayogatā ||
sbh3.2:41.2: āha | ādikarmikastatprathamakarmika evaṁ vyāpini lakṣaṇe vyavasthāpite ekāgratāyām āvaraṇaviśuddheśca mithyāprayogaṁ ca varjayati | samyakprayoge ca śikṣate |
sbh3.2:41.3: sa tatprathamata ekāgratāṁ prahāṇābhiratiṁ cādhigamiṣyāmīti caturbhirmanaskāraiḥ prayujyate |
sbh3.2:41.4: katamaiścaturbhiḥ — cittasantāpanīyena manaskāreṇa, cittābhiṣyandanīyena, praśrabdhijanakena, jñānadarśanaviśodhakena ca manaskāreṇa |
sbh3.2:41.6: āha | yenāyaṁ manaskāreṇa | saṁvejanīyeṣu dharmeṣu cittaṁ saṁvejayati ayaṁ cittasantāpano manaskāraḥ |
sbh3.2:41.8: yenāyaṁ prasadanīyena manaskāreṇa cittam abhipramodayati — ayaṁ cittābhiṣyandano manaskāraḥ |
sbh3.2:41.10: āha | yenāyaṁ manaskāreṇa kālena kālaṁ cittaṁ saṁvejanīyeṣu dharmeṣu saṁvejayitvā saṁvejya kālena kālam abhipramodanīyeṣu dharmeṣu cittam abhipramodayitvā abhipramodyādhyātmaṁ śamathayati |
sbh3.2:41.11: nirnimittāyāṁ | nirvikalpakatāyām evaṁ sthāpayatyekāgrāṁ smṛtiṁ pravarttayati |
sbh3.2:41.12: yenāsya hetunā, yena pratyayena kāyacittadauṣṭhulyapratipakṣeṇa kāyacittahlādanakarī kāyapraśrabdhiścittapraśrabdhiścotpadyate |
sbh3.2:41.15: yena manaskāreṇa kālena kālaṁ cittena tathādhyātmaṁ saṁśayam iti saṁśamayati tena punaḥ punarabhīkṣṇam adhiprajñaṁ dharmavipaśyanāyāṁ yogaṁ karoti |
sbh3.2:41.16: yaduta tam evādhyātmaṁ cetaḥśamathaṁ niśritya | ayam ucyate jñānadarśanaviśodhano manaskāraḥ |
sbh3.2:42.1: katamaḥ kālena kālaṁ saṁvejanīyeṣu dharmeṣu cittaṁ saṁvejayati — evamasya taccittaṁ taptaṁ bhavati | saṁtaptamudvignaṁ saṁvignaṁ — yad utāsravasthānīyeṣu ca dharmeṣu |
sbh3.2:42.3: āha | catvāri | tadyathā ātmavipattiḥ, paravipattiśca — vartamāne samavahite saṁmukhībhūte yoniśo manasikārānvayāt saṁvejanīyaṁ sthānaṁ bhavati |
sbh3.2:42.4: tatrātmasaṁpattiḥ | parasaṁpattiśca — abhyatīte kṣaṇe niruddhe vigate vipariṇate yoniśo manasikārānvayāt saṁvejanīyaṁ sthānaṁ bhavati |
sbh3.2:42.5: sa kālena kālam abhipramodanīyeṣu dharmeṣu cittam abhipramodayati | tasyābhipramodayataḥ, evamasya taccittaṁ snigdhaṁ bhavatyārdraṁ ca, dravañcācchaṁ ca, prasannaṁ ca |
sbh3.2:42.7: āha | trividhāḥ — catvāro 'bhipramodādhiṣṭhānaṁ: ratnāni, śikṣāpadapāriśuddhiḥ, ātmani ca viśeṣādhigamasaṁbhāvanājātasya cetaso asaṁkocaḥ |
sbh3.2:42.8: sa evaṁ ratnānyanusaraṁś cittam abhipramodayati: 'lābhā me sulabdhāḥ — yasya me śāstā tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṁbuddhaḥ |
sbh3.2:42.9: lābhā me sulabdhāḥ — yo 'haṁ svākhyāte dharmavinaye pravrajitaḥ |
sbh3.2:42.10: lābhā me sulabdhāḥ — yasya me sabrahmacāriṇaḥ śīlavanto guṇavantaḥ peśalāḥ, kalyāṇadharmāṇaḥ |
sbh3.2:42.11: bhadrakaṁ me maraṇaṁ bhaviṣyati | bhadrikā kālakriyā, bhadrako abhisaṁparāyaḥ |'
sbh3.2:43.1: kathaṁ śikṣāpadapāriśuddhiṁ śīlapāriśuddhim anusmaraṁś cittam abhipramodayati |
sbh3.2:43.2: 'lābhā me sulabdhāḥ — so 'haṁ śāstari tathāgate arhati samyaksaṁbuddhe, tasya ca svākhyāte dharmavinaye, tatra ca supratipanne śrāvakasaṁghe, aham ebhiḥ sabrahmacāribhiḥ śīlasāmānyagataḥ, śikṣāsāmānyagato, maitrakāyavāṅmanaskarmāntaḥ, dṛṣṭisāmānyagataḥ, sādhāraṇaparibhogī |'
sbh3.2:43.3: evaṁ śikṣāpadapāriśuddhiṁ, śīlapāriśuddhim anusmaraṁś cittam abhipramodayati — yaduta vipratisārapūrvakeṇa prāmodyena |
sbh3.2:43.4: tatra katham ātmano adhigamasaṁbhāvanām adhiṣṭhāya — 'bhavyo aham asmy evaṁ pariśuddhaśīlaḥ |
sbh3.2:43.5: pratibalaśca bhājanabhūtaśca | ebhiḥ sabrahmacāribhiḥ śīlasāmānyagato, dṛṣṭisāmānyagataḥ, sadbhiḥ sāmānyagataiḥ samyaggataiḥ satpuruṣaiḥ, bhavyo aham asmyevaṁbhūta, evaṁ pratipanno, dṛṣṭa eva dharme aprāptasya prāptaye, anadhigatasyādhigamāya, asākṣātkṛtasya sākṣātkriyāyai' iti prāmodyam utpādayatyevam ātmano adhigamasaṁbhāvanādhiṣṭhānena cittam abhipramodayati |
sbh3.2:44.1: api ca | yad anena pūrveṇāparam ārabdhavīryeṇa viharatā viśeṣādhigamaḥ kṛto bhavati |
sbh3.2:44.2: tadanusmarann uttari ca viśeṣādhigamam abhiśraddadhāc cittam abhipramodayati — ayam aparaḥ [adhiṣṭhānaḥ] |
sbh3.2:44.3: saṁvejanīyeṣu dharmeṣu cittam abhisaṁtāpayann āsravaṁ — āsravasthānīyebhyo dharmebhyaścittaṁ vimukhīkaroti | viguṇīkaroti | prātimukhyenāvasthāpayati | viśleṣayati |
sbh3.2:44.4: abhipramodanīyeṣu dharmeṣv abhipramodayann abhiṣyandayan — naiṣkramyapravivekajeṣu dharmeṣu sasnehaṁ cittam abhimukhīkaroty upaśleṣayati | ramayati | saṁyojayati |
sbh3.2:44.5: evam asya taccittaṁ yābhyāṁ dvābhyāṁ dharmābhyāṁ — sarvakṛṣṇapakṣavimukhaṁ sarvaśuklapakṣābhimukhaṁ ca pravarttate — yad uta saṁvegapraharṣābhyām |
sbh3.2:44.6: yataścittam evaṁ kṛṣṇapakṣavimukhaṁ ca cittasantāpanīyena manaskāreṇa śuklapakṣābhimukhaṁ ca kṛtvā abhiṣyandanīyena manaskāreṇa, kālena kālam adhyātmaṁ ca pradadhāti — yad uta cetaḥśamathena praśrabdhijanakena manaskāreṇa |
sbh3.2:44.7: kālena kālaṁ dharmān vicinoti, pravicinoti, parivitarkayati, parimīmāṁsām āpadyate — jñānadarśanaviśodhakena manaskāreṇa |
sbh3.2:44.8: evam asya taccittaṁ kālena kālaṁ śamathavipaśyanāparigṛhītaṁ, sarvākārasarvaguṇahetūpakṛtaṁ, teṣāṁ teṣāṁ rātridivasānām atyayāt, kṣaṇalavamuhūrttānāṁ ca viśeṣāya paraiti |
sbh3.2:45.1: tadyathā jātarūparajataṁ dakṣeṇa karmāreṇa vā, karmārāntevāsinā vā, kālena kālaṁ yadā saṁtāpitaṁ ca bhavati, vigatamalakaṣāye bhāve, abhiṣyanditaṁ ca bhavati — tatra tatrālaṁkārakarmaṇā mṛdukarmaṇyatāyogenābhimukhīkṛtaṁ bhavati |
sbh3.2:45.2: tam enaṁ dakṣaḥ karmāro vā karmārāntevāsī vā tadupamena śilpajñānena karmāntavastunā yatreṣṭā alaṁkāravikṛtistatra pariṇamayati —
sbh3.2:45.3: evam eva yoginā yadā taccittam abhidhyādimalakaṣāye vimukhībhāvenodvejitaṁ ca bhavati, kliṣṭadaurmanasyavimukhībhāvena cābhipramoditaṁ bhavati,
sbh3.2:45.4: tam enaṁ yogī yatra yatra niyojayati — śamathapakṣe vā vipaśyanāpakṣe vā — tatra tatra sūpaśliṣṭaṁ ca bhavati, sulagnaṁ cāvikalaṁ cāvikampyaṁ ca |
sbh3.2:46.1: tatra katham ādikarmikaḥ tatprathamakarmiko manaskārabhāvanāyāṁ viniyujyate |
sbh3.2:46.2: yathāyaṁ viniyujyamānaḥ pratipadyamānaśca spṛśati tatprathamataḥ prahāṇābhiratiṁ cittasyaikāgratāṁ |
sbh3.2:46.3: iha yogajño yogaprayukte ādikarmike tatprathamata evam avavadati —
sbh3.2:46.4: 'ehi tvaṁ, bhadramukha, trīṇi nimittodgrāhakāni kāraṇāni niśritya — yad uta dṛṣṭamvā śrutamvā, cintānumānādhipateyaṁ vā parikalpaṁ — pañca nimittānyudgṛhṇīṣva:
sbh3.2:46.5: saṁvejanīyaṁ, prasadanīyam, ādīnavanimittam, ālokanimittaṁ, vasturūpaṇānimittaṁ ca |
sbh3.2:46.6: sa cetsa yogaprayukta ādikarmiko rāgacarito bhavatyaśubhāvineyaḥ — kathaṁ sa pañcānāṁ nimittānām udgrahaṇāyāvabodhyate |
sbh3.2:46.7: evam avabodhyate — 'ehi tvaṁ, bhadramukha | yaṁ yam eva grāmamvā nigamamvopaniśritya viharasi | sa cedanyatra grāme nigame vānyatamaṁ puruṣamvā striyamvā ābādhikaṁ śṛṇoṣi — duḥkhitaṁ bāḍhaglānaṁ, mṛtamvā kālagataṁ, puruṣamvā striyamvā |
sbh3.2:46.8: api tu tasya puruṣasya vā striyā vānyatamānyatamaṁ mitrāmātyajñātisālohitaṁ, paracakrakṛtamvā tadgrāmaparyāpannasya janakāyasya bhojanavyasanaṁ, agnidāhakṛtamvā, udakāpaharaṇakṛtamvā, kuvihitapraviṇāśakṛtamvā, kuprayuktakarmāntapralujyanākṛtamvā, apriyadāyādādhigamakṛtamvā, kulāṅgāra-vipraṇāśakṛtamvā |
sbh3.2:46.9: no cecchṛṇoṣi — api tu pratyakṣaṁ paśyasi |
sbh3.2:46.10: no vānyasmin grāmanigame, no ca tasminneva grāmanigame — na pareṣām, anya-rairapi tu ātmanaiva spṛṣṭo bhavasi — śārīrikābhirvedanābhirduḥkhābhistīvrābhir' iti vistareṇa pūrvavat |
sbh3.2:46.11: 'sarvaṁ dṛṣṭvā śrutvā caivaṁ cittaṁ saṁvejaya — duḥkho batāyaṁ saṁsāraḥ, kṛcchra ātmabhāvapratilabdho yatremā evaṁrūpā ātmanaśca pareṣāṁ ca vipattaya upalabhyante |
sbh3.2:46.12: yaduta ārogyavipattirapi, jātivipattirapi, bhogavipattirapi, vyādhirvyādhidharmatā ca, maraṇaṁ maraṇadharmatā ca | api caikeṣāṁ śīlavipattirapi, dṛṣṭivipattirapi yato nidānaṁ sattvā dṛṣṭe ca dharme duḥkhavihāriṇo bhavanti | saṁparāye ca durgatigāminaḥ |
sbh3.2:46.13: yāśca saṁpattayo dṛṣṭadharmasukhavihārāya, abhisaṁparāye ca sugatigamanāya — tā apyanityāḥ, tāsām apyanityatā prajñāyate |
sbh3.2:46.14: vipattiścet saṁmukhībhūtā, vimukhībhūtā tasminsamaye saṁpattiḥ | asaṁmukhībhūtāyām api vipattau durlabhā saṁpattirvināśadharmiṇī ca |'
sbh3.2:46.15: evaṁ ca punaścittamudvejayitvā sādhu ca suṣṭhu ca yoniśaḥ pradadhatsva —
sbh3.2:46.16: 'anāśvāsyam etatsthānam aviśvāsyaṁ | yatsaṁsāre me saṁsarataḥ, aparinirvṛtasyāvimuktacetasaḥ — etā vipattisaṁpattayo, na me saṁmukhībhāvaṁ, vimukhībhāvaṁ ca gaccheyuḥ |
sbh3.2:46.17: na vā ato nidānaṁ me duḥkham utpadyate — tīvraṁ, kharaṁ, kaṭukam, anālāpyam, alabhyam etatsthānaṁ — tasmādetatsarvārtham adhipatiṁ kṛtvā prahāṇaratiratena me bhavitavyam apramattena |
sbh3.2:46.18: evaṁ bahulavihāriṇo me apyevāsyānarthasyākriyā syād' iti yoniśaḥ pradadhatsva — evaṁ tvaṁ saṁvejanīyaṁ nimittam udgṛhya, punaḥ prasadanīyaṁ nimittam udgṛhṇīṣva |
sbh3.2:47.1: evaṁ ca punarudgṛhṇīṣva | ātmanaḥ śīlāni pratyavekṣasva |
sbh3.2:47.2: 'kiṁ pariśuddhāni me śīlānyapariśuddhāni vā — yo me smṛtisaṁpramoṣādvā, anādarādvā, kleśapracuratayā vā, avyutpannato vā asti kaścicchikṣāvyatikramaḥ |
sbh3.2:47.3: vyatikrānte vā me, mayā śikṣāṁ yathādharmaṁ pratikṛtya, adhyāśayena ca punarakaraṇāya cittamutpāditaṁ |
sbh3.2:47.4: kaccinme kartavyaṁ kṛtam, akartavyañca na kṛtaṁ — samāsataḥ | kaccidadhyāśayasaṁpanno asmi, prayogasaṁpannaśca — yaduta śikṣāpadeṣu |'
sbh3.2:47.5: evaṁ na te pratyavekṣamāṇena, sa cetpariśuddhaḥ śīlaskandhaḥ, na punaste cetanā karaṇīyā: 'kaccinme vipratisāra utpadyeta' — api tu dharmataiveyaṁ — yad evaṁ viśuddhaśīlasyāvipratisāra utpadyate |
sbh3.2:47.6: evaṁ cāvipratisāriṇā na cetanā karaṇīyā: 'kaccinme prāmodyam utpadyeta' — api tu dharmataiveyaṁ yad avipratisāriṇaḥ prāmodyam utpadyate |
sbh3.2:47.7: anena tāvad ekena prāmodyādhiṣṭhānena dvayāvipratisārapūrvakaṁ prāmodyam utpādayitavyam |
sbh3.2:47.9: sa cetpunarbhavasi pūrveṇāparaṁ parīttasyāpi viśeṣādhigame — prītirjanayitavyā: 'bhavyo aham asmi, pratibalaḥ | evaṁ pariśuddhaśīlo bhagavataḥ śikṣāsu supratiṣṭhitaḥ |
sbh3.2:47.10: dṛṣṭe dharme prāptasya prāptaye, anadhigatasyādhigamāya, asākṣātkṛtasya sākṣātkriyāyai' — anenāpyadhiṣṭhānena mānasaṁ saṁpraharṣaya |
sbh3.2:47.11: sa cetpunarlābhī bhavati pūrveṇāparaṁ paracittasyāpi viśeṣādhigamasya — sa tvaṁ tam adhipatiṁ kṛtvā pareṣāṁ ca paripūrṇe viśeṣādhigame, yaduta tathāgate, tathāgataśrāvakeṣu vā, ātmanaścottariviśeṣādhigamasaṁpratyayajāto mānasaṁ saṁpraharṣaya iti |
sbh3.2:48.1: evaṁ prasadanīyaṁ nimittam udgrāhayatyudgrāhayitvā hi punaḥ samanuśāsti —
sbh3.2:48.2: 'ehi tvaṁ, bhadramukha — saṁvejanīyena nimittena saṁtāpitacittaḥ, prasadanīyena cittenābhiṣyanditacittaḥ — prahāyābhidhyādaurmanasyaṁ loke bahulaṁ vihariṣyasi |
sbh3.2:48.3: yatra ca yatrālambane prayokṣyase — śamathapakṣe vā vipaśyanāpakṣe vā — tatra tatrālambane cittaṁ sthitaṁ bhaviṣyati |
sbh3.2:48.5: evaṁ kṛṣṇapakṣavimukhībhūtaḥ śuklapakṣābhimukhībhūtasya yaduta saṁvegābhiṣyandanatayā — sarvaṁ punarasyādīnavanimittam udgṛhṇīṣva — yaduta nimittebhyo vipakṣebhyaścopakleśebhyaśca |
sbh3.2:48.6: tatra nimittāni rūpanimittādīni daśa, vitarkāḥ kāmavitarkādayo 'ṣṭau, upakleśāḥ kāmacchandādayaḥ pañca |
sbh3.2:48.7: evaṁ ca punasteṣv ādīnavam udgṛhṇīṣva — 'itīmāni nimittāni vyāpārakārakāṇi cittasya | itīme vitarkā unmuktasaṁkṣobhakārakāś cittasya | itīme upakleśā anupaśamakārakāś cittasya |
sbh3.2:48.8: yaśca cittasya vyāpāro nimittakṛtaḥ | yaścon-muktasaṁkṣobho vitarkakṛtaḥ | yaścānupakleśa upakleśakṛtaḥ — duḥkhāvihāra eṣa cittasya |
sbh3.2:48.9: tasmād ime nimittavitarkopakleśāḥ duḥkhā anāryā anarthopasaṁhitāś cittavikṣepasaṁkṣobhakarāḥ' iti |
sbh3.2:48.10: evaṁ ādīnavanimittam udgṛhya cittaikāgratāyāṁ, cittasthitau, cittāvikṣepe ṣaḍbhirākārair nimittam udgṛhāṇa — yaduta nimittasaṁjñayā nirnimitte, avyāpārasaṁjñayā, nirvikalpasaṁjñayā, nirvikalpe cānautsukyāsaṁkṣobhasaṁjñayā, upaśamasaṁjñayā, upaśamena niṣparidāha-nairvṛtya-aśubhasaṁjñayā |
sbh3.2:49.1: evaṁ nimittam udgṛhya punaraparaṁ cālokanimittam udgṛhāṇa — yaduta pradīpādvā, agniskandhaprabhāsādvā, sūryamaṇḍalādvā, candramaṇḍalādvā nimittam udgṛhya, śmaśānādyupasaṁkramya, vinīlakādvā nimittam udgṛhāṇa,
sbh3.2:49.2: yāvad asthināmvā, asthiśaṁkalikānāmvā — no cecchmaśānādapi tu citrakṛtādvā, kāṣṭhaśmaśānakṛtādvā nimittam udgṛhāṇa |
sbh3.2:49.3: udgṛhya śayanāsanamupasaṁkrama — upasaṁkramyāraṇyagato vā, vṛkṣamūlagato vā, śūnyāgāragato vā, mañce vā, pīṭhe vā, tṛṇasaṁstarake vā niṣīda |
sbh3.2:49.4: paryaṅkamābhujya, pādau prakṣālya, ṛjuṁ kāyaṁ praṇidhāya, pratimukhīṁ smṛtim upasthāpya, niṣadya tatprathamata ekāgratāyāṁ cittāvikṣepe smṛtyupanibaddhaṁ kuru |
sbh3.2:49.5: tatra ca ṣaṭsaṁjñāḥ — nirvikalpasaṁjñām, upasaṁśamasaṁjñāṁ, nirvyāpārasaṁjñām, anautsukyāsaṁkṣobhasaṁjñām, niṣparidāha-nairvṛtya-aśubhasaṁjñāṁ |
sbh3.2:49.6: tatra ca te vikṣepāvikṣepaparijñāvadhānaṁ pratyupasthitaṁ bhavatu — yena vikṣepāvikṣepaparijñāvadhānena tathā tathā nimittavitarkopakleśeṣu vikṣepañca parijānīṣva, cittaikāgratāyāñca ṣaṭsaṁjñābhāvanānugatāyām avikṣepaṁ |
sbh3.2:49.7: tatra ca vikṣepāvikṣepayoḥ tathā tathāvahito bhava yathā te ekāgratopanibaddhā, adhyātmaṁ cetaḥśamathopanibaddhā sarvā cittasantatiś cittadhārā paurvāparyeṇa nirnimittā pravarteta, nirvikalpā upaśāntā |
sbh3.2:49.8: sa cetpunaḥ smṛtisaṁpramoṣāt tathā śamathaprāpte cetasi nimittavitarkopakleśā anabhyāsadoṣād ābhāsam āgacchanti, sukham ādarśayanti, ālambanīkurvanti —
sbh3.2:49.9: teṣūtpannotpanneṣu smṛtyamanasikāraḥ kartavyaḥ — yaduta pūrvadṛṣṭam evam adhipatiṁ kṛtvā evaṁ tadālambanam anusmṛtyamanasikāreṇa vibhāvitaṁ, viśvastam anābhāsagatāyām avasthāpitaṁ bhaviṣyati |
sbh3.2:49.10: taccaitad, bhadramukha, sūkṣmam ālambanaṁ — duḥpratividhyam asya te prativedhāya tīvracchandaśca vyāyāmaśca karaṇīyaḥ |
sbh3.2:50.3: atha puruṣa āgacched abālajātīyaḥ | taṁ kaścidevaṁ vadet:
sbh3.2:50.4: "idaṁ te bhoḥ puruṣa tailapātrapūrṇaṁ samatittikam anabhiṣekyam antarā ca janakāyaḥ sannipateta | sā khalu janapadakalyāṇī antarā ca mahāsamājaṁ pariharttavyam |
sbh3.2:50.5: ayaṁ ca te utkṣiptāsiko vadhakapuruṣaḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ samanubaddhaḥ | sa cet tvam asmāt tailapātrādekabindum api pṛthivyāṁ nipātayiṣyasi, tataste utkṣiptāsiko vadhakapuruṣa ucchinnamūlaṁ śiraḥ prapātayiṣyati |"
sbh3.2:50.6: kiṁ manyadhve bhikṣavaḥ — api nu sa puruṣaḥ amanasikṛtya tailapātraṁ, amanasikṛtya utkṣiptāsikaṁ vadhakapuruṣaṁ, janapadakalyāṇīṁ manasi kuryāt, mahājanasamājamvā?'
sbh3.2:50.7: 'no, no, bhadanta, tatkasya hetoḥ — tathā hi tena puruṣeṇotkṣiptāsiko vadhakapuruṣaḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ samanubaddho dṛṣṭaḥ |
sbh3.2:50.8: tasyaivaṁ syāt: "sa ced aham asmāttailapātrādekabindum api pṛthivyāṁ pātayiṣyāmi, ato me utkṣiptāsiko vadhakapuruṣaḥ ucchinnamūlaṁ śiraḥ prapātayiṣyati |"
sbh3.2:50.9: nānyatra sa puruṣaḥ amanasikṛtya janapadakalyāṇīṁ mahāsamājaṁ vā, tad eva tailapātraṁ sarvacetasā samanvāhṛtya samyageva pariharet |
sbh3.2:50.10: evameva, bhikṣavaḥ — ye kecit catvāri smṛtyupasthānāni satkṛtya bhāvayanti, gurukṛtya sarvacetasā samanvāhṛtya, te me ime śrāvakāḥ |'
sbh3.2:50.17: 'satkṛtya viharati, na caikabindum api pṛthivyāṁ pātayati' iti vikṣepāvikṣepaparijñānāvadhānaparigṛhītasya śamathamārgasya etadadhivacanaṁ — yenāyaṁ sarvāṁ cittasantatiṁ cittadhārāṁ nirnimittāṁ nirvikalpām upaśāntāṁ vīryabalena nirantarāṁ paurvāparyeṇa pravarttayati |
sbh3.2:51.1: tam enam evaṁ śamathaprayuktam ādikarmikaṁ yogī samanuśāsti —
sbh3.2:51.2: 'yāvatte, bhadramukha, evaṁ śamathamārgaprayuktasya, evam upāyaparigṛhītaṁ smṛtisaṁprajanyasahagataṁ sābhirāmaṁ cittaṁ bhavati — tāvatte śamathamārga eva bhāvayitavyaḥ |
sbh3.2:51.3: sa cetpunaranabhyāsadoṣān na ramate sopāyaṁ ca tadālambanaṁ — tasmān nirvikalpādālambanād vyutthāya savikalpa ālambane smṛtyupanibaddhaṁ kurute |
sbh3.2:51.4: yad eva te pūrvodgṛhītamaśubhanimittaṁ — tad eva manasi kuru tatprathamato nimittamātrānusāriṇyā vipaśyanayā — yad uta vinīlakamvā, vipūyakamvā, yāvadasthiśaṁkalikāmvā |
sbh3.2:51.5: tathā prayuktaśca tatprathamavata ekaṁ vinīlakam adhimucyasva, yāvad ekām asthiśaṁkalikāṁ |
sbh3.2:51.6: yataścātra kṛtaparicayo bhavasi, prabhāsvaraśca te 'dhimokṣaḥ pravartate — tadālambanaṁ dvau tadā dvau, trīṇi, catvāri, pañca, daśa, viṁśa, triṁśat, catvāriṁśat, pañcāśat, vinīlaka-śataṁ, vinīlaka-sahasraṁ, yāvatsarvā diśo vidiśaśca pramāṇākāreṇa pūrvāṁ nirantarām adhimucyasva |
sbh3.2:51.7: yeṣāṁ na syād avakāśaḥ antato daṇḍaviṣṭambhanakoṭimātrapyaṁ |
sbh3.2:51.8: yathā vinīlakānām evaṁ yāvad asthiśaṁkalikānāṁ sarvam evam adhimuktimanaskāraṁ niśritya bhūtamanaskāram avatara |
sbh3.2:51.9: evaṁ ca punaravatara: "yāvantyetāni vinīlakāni mayādhimuktāni yāvad asthiśaṁkalikā — ato apramāṇavarāṇi me pūrvāntam ārabhya, tatra tatra bhavagaticyutyupapādeṣu, mṛtasya kālagatasya yāni vinīlakāni nirvṛttāni, yāvad asthiśaṁkalikā nirvṛtyāṁ;
sbh3.2:51.10: yeṣāṁ pūrvā koṭir na prajñāyate, nivartamānānāṁ — tāḥ sa cetkaścit saṁharet, saṁhṛtāś ca na vinaśyeyuḥ, na ca pūtībhaveyuḥ — nāsti sa pṛthivīpradeśo yatra teṣām avakāśaḥ syāt |
sbh3.2:51.11: ekakalpikā nāmapi, tāvad yāvad asthiśaṁkalikānāṁ — sa cet kaścit saṁhārako bhavet — tāsāṁ syāt saṁhṛtānāṁ vipulapārśvaparvatasamā rāśiḥ |
sbh3.2:51.12: yathā pūrvasyāntare pūrvāntamārabhya evam aparāntamapi yāvat — duḥkhasyāntaṁ na kariṣyāmi — evaṁ hi tvam abhiyuṁkṣva |"
sbh3.2:51.14: na caitāni vinīlakāni yāvad asthiśaṁkalikā yā vipaśyanāprayuktena sakṛd vipaśyitavyāni | nānyatraikaṁ vinīlakam adhimucya punaścittaṁ śamayitavyam — tāvac ca tadvinīlakamadhimoktavyaṁ yāvat tasminnālambane sābhirāma-prabhāsvaraṁ nopāyāsena paryavanahyate |
sbh3.2:51.15: na tāvatkālakaraṇīyaṁ bhavati | tasmin samaye adhyātmaṁ saṁśamayitavyam | yathā vinīlakam evaṁ yāvad asthiśaṁkalikā ekā — evaṁ yāvad apramāṇā anenaiva nayena veditavyāḥ |
sbh3.2:51.16: cittam adhyātmaṁ saṁśamayitvā saṁśamya vimoktavyās — tataḥ sarvapaścādapramāṇāni vinīlakāni, apramāṇā yāvad asthiśaṁkalikā adhyātmaṁ cittābhisaṁkṣepeṇa vibhāvayatyanābhāsagatāyāṁ sthāpayati |
sbh3.2:51.17: na ca tāni nimittāni utsṛjati || savikalpāni nāpi ca kalpayati | nānyatra tadālambanam eva nirnimittaṁ nirvikalpam upaśāntaṁ cittam avasthāpayati |
sbh3.2:52.2: 'yatte, bhadramukha, pūrvam evālokanimittam udgṛhītaṁ — tat tvaṁ śamathapakṣaprayoge api manasi kuru, vipaśyanāpakṣaprayoge api | ālokasahagatena cittena, saprabhāsasahagatena, prabhāsvareṇānandhakāreṇa śamathavipaśyanāṁ bhāvaya |
sbh3.2:52.3: evaṁ ca te śamathavipaśyanāmārge ālokasaṁjñāṁ bhāvayataḥ, sa cedādita eva avispaṣṭo 'dhivimokṣo bhaviṣyaty ālambane samyagābhāsaḥ, sa tena hetunā, tena pratyayena bhāvanābhāsād viśiṣṭatā bhaviṣyati, pracurābhāsagatā ca |
sbh3.2:52.4: sa cetpunarādita eva vispaṣṭo bhaviṣyati pracurābhāsaḥ — sa bhūyasyā mātrayā vispaṣṭataratāṁ pracurābhāsataratāṁ ca gamiṣyati |'
sbh3.2:52.5: sa tvam etat saṁveganimittena sūdgṛhītena, prasadanīyanimittena, śamathanimittena, vipaśyanānimittena, ālokanimittena sūdgṛhītena, kālam adhyātmaṁ cittaṁ saṁśamayan kālena kālaṁ dharmān vicinvan, nimittamātrānusāriṇyā vipaśyanayā, smṛtyupasthāneṣv avatara —
sbh3.2:52.6: yad utāśubhāprayogamevādhipatiṁ kṛtvā, evaṁ ca punarvicinvan bahirdhā ṣaṭtriṁśato dravyāṇi kāyāt keśādi-prasāvaparyantāntaṁ nimittam udgṛhya, adhyātmamapy etāni sarvāṇy aśucidravyāṇy adhimucyādhyātmaṁ cittaṁ saṁśamaya —
sbh3.2:52.7: idaṁ te bhaviṣyatyadhyātmaṁ kāye kāyānupaśyanāyāḥ — yad utātmano 'ntaḥkāyam ārabhya |
sbh3.2:52.8: sa tvaṁ punarapi bahirdhā aśubhānimittenodgṛhītena vinīlakaṁ cādhimucyasva, yāvad asthi vā śaṁkalikāmvā, parīttena vādhimokṣeṇa, mahadgatena vā apramāṇena vā — adhimucyādhimucyādhyātmaṁ cittaṁ saṁśamaya |
sbh3.2:52.9: idaṁ te bhaviṣyati bahirdhā kāye kāyānupaśyanāyā — yad uta parasāntatikaṁ bahiḥkāyam ārabhya |
sbh3.2:52.10: sa tvaṁ punarapyātmano 'ntaḥkāye 'śubhatāparibhāvitena cetasā, parakāye cāntarbahiścāśubhatāparibhāvitena cetasātmānaṁ mriyamāṇam adhimucyasva, mṛtamvā punaḥ śmaśāne abhinirhriyamāṇam, abhinirhṛtamvā śmaśāne choritaṁ, choritamvā vinīlakāvasthaṁ, vipūyakāvasthaṁ, yāvad asthiśaṁkālikāvasthamadhimucyasva |
sbh3.2:52.11: idaṁ te bhaviṣyatyadhyātmabahirdhā kāye kāyānupaśyanāyāḥ sattvaṁ |
sbh3.2:52.12: punarapi catvāro 'rūpiṇaḥ skandhāḥ śrutacintādhipateyena parikalpanimittagrāheṇa triṣu bhāgeṣv adhimucyasva — śamathapakṣye, vikṣepapakṣye, vipaśyanāpakṣye ca |
sbh3.2:52.13: yad ādhyātmaṁ cittam abhisaṁkṣipasi, tatra nirnimitta-nirvikalpopaśamākārā, nirvyāpārānutsukāsaṁkṣobhaniḥparidāha-nairvṛtyasukhasaṁjñākārā, avikṣepālambanā vedanādayaścatvāro arūpiṇaḥ skandhāḥ |
sbh3.2:52.14: pratikṣaṇaṁ pratikṣaṇam anyonyatayā navanavaniṣpurāṇatayā pravartanta ityadhimucyasva |
sbh3.2:52.15: idaṁ te bhaviṣyatyadhyātmabahirdhā vedanāsu, citte, dharmeṣu dharmānupaśyanāyāḥ sattvaṁ |
sbh3.2:52.16: ye pūrvaṁ viṣayopādānā, viṣayālambanā asamāhitabhūmipatitā abhyapatitāḥ kṣīṇā, ye caitarhi smṛtisaṁpramoṣāc cittakṣepe satyutpadyante nimittavitarkopakleśālambanādhipateyā vedanādayaścatvāro arūpiṇaḥ skandhāḥ — teṣām āyāpāyikatāṁ, tāvatkālikatām, itvarapratyupasthāyitāṁ, sādīnavatāṁ, sādhruvatām, anāśvāsikatām adhimucyasva |
sbh3.2:52.17: idaṁ te bhaviṣyati bahirdhā vedanā-citta-dharmānupaśyanāyāḥ sattvam |
sbh3.2:52.18: punarapi vipaśyanānimittam udgṛhya sanimitte saṁkalpe manaskāre sthitaḥ — ye savikalpasanimittālambanādhipateyā adhyātmam utpadyante vedanādayaścatvāro arūpiṇaḥ skandhāḥ, teṣāṁ pratikṣaṇaṁ navanavatāṁ niṣpurāṇatāmanyonyatāṁ pūrvavad adhimucyasva |
sbh3.2:52.19: idaṁ te bhaviṣyati bahirdhā vedanāyāṁ, citte, dharmeṣu dharmānupaśyanāyāḥ sattvam |
sbh3.2:52.20: evaṁ hi tvam aśubhāprayogam adhipatiṁ kṛtvā catvāri smṛtyupasthānānyavatīrṇo bhaviṣyasi | smṛtyupasthāne, prayoge api ca te kālena kālaṁ śamathavipaśyanāyāṁ prayoktavyam |
sbh3.2:53.1: sa tvam evam upasthitayā smṛtyā caturṣu smṛtyupasthāneṣu — yaṁ yam eva grāmaṁ vā nigamaṁ vopaniśritya viharasi, sa tvaṁ tam eva grāmaṁ vā nigamaṁ vā tannityena cittena, tatpravaṇena, tatprābhāreṇa ālambanam ālambananimittam utsṛjatā piṇḍāya praviśa |
sbh3.2:53.2: caṇḍasya hastinaḥ, caṇḍasyāśvasya, caṇḍasya goḥ, caṇḍasya kurarasya, ahiśvabhrasthāṇukaṇṭakapalvalaprapātasyandika-gūthakaṭhalla-pāpike yā caryā śayanāsanaparivarjanā — arakṣitaste ātmā bhavati |
sbh3.2:53.3: yeṣu ca te viṣayanimitteṣv indriyāṇi prerayitavyāni, teṣv anābhogatayā asaṁvṛtāny indriyāṇi bhavantu; yeṣu vā punarnimitteṣv indriyāṇi prerayitavyāni, teṣu teṣūpasthitā smṛtir bhavatu — yad uta kleśāsamudācārāya |
sbh3.2:53.4: sa tvam evaṁ surakṣitena kāyena, susaṁvṛtair indriyaiḥ, sūpasthitayā smṛtyā, tadgatena mānasena mātrayā piṇḍapātaṁ paribhuṁkṣva | mitabhāgīṇī ca bhava, sārdhaṁ gṛhasthapravrajitair yuktakābhāṇī, kālabhāṇī, ārjavabhāṇī, praśāntabhāṇī |
sbh3.2:53.5: adharmyā ca te tvayā kathā sarveṇa sarvaṁ parivarjayitavyā | dharmyām api te tvayā kathāṁ kathayatā na vigṛhya kathā karaṇīyā |
sbh3.2:53.6: tatkasya hetoḥ — vigṛhya kathāsaṁrambhānuyogamanuyuktasya puruṣapudgalasya viharataḥ kathābāhulye cittaṁ santiṣṭhate | tathā bāhulye saty auddhatyam, auddhatye saty avyupaśamaḥ | avyupaśāntacittasyārāc cittaṁ samādherbhavati |
sbh3.2:53.7: na tvam evaṁcārī tvaritatvaritam anutsṛṣṭenālambanena me adya śamathavipaśyanāyāṁ yathodgṛhītenaiva nimittena pratanukāritayā vā, antakāritayā ca — yogaṁ kuru | te sa tvam agnimathanaprayogeṇa ca sātatyasatkṛtyaprayogatayā pratatakārī bhava |
sbh3.2:53.8: evaṁ tu punaścittaṁ praṇidhatsva — 'sa cedyāvadāyurjambūdvīpe sarveṣāṁ jaṁbūdvīpakānāṁ manuṣyāṇām abhūt tatsarvam abhisamastaṁ mama ekasyaitarhi syāt — so 'haṁ tāvad apramāṇenāyuṣā pramāṇayogaprayogeṇa ca sātatyasatkṛtyaprayogatayā pratatakārī bhavāmi |'
sbh3.2:53.9: evaṁ ca punaścittaṁ praṇidhatsva — 'sa cedyāvadāyurjambūdvīpe manasikāre śamathavipaśyanāyāṁ yogaṁ na riñcayam' — yaduta asyaiva yogaprayogasya mahāphalatāṁ mahānuśaṁsatāṁ ca viditvā prāgevāsmin paripraṇidhatte āyuṣi itvare jīvite, dūram api gatvā varṣaśatike parigaṇyamāne mauntike |
sbh3.2:53.10: evaṁ hi tvaṁ yathānuśiṣṭaḥ pratatakārī vātyantakārī ca — yasyārthe prahāṇam upagatastasyārthasyābādhako bhaviṣyasi |
sbh3.2:53.11: tatprathamatas taṁ prakṣyasi — mṛdukāṁ kāyapraśrabdhiṁ, cittaikāgratāṁ — tataścottari vipulā laukika-lokottarāṁ saṁpadam ārāgayiṣyasi |
sbh3.2:54.1: evam ayam ādikarmikastatprathamakarmikaḥ aśubhāprayukto yogajñenācāryeṇa codyamānaḥ samyak codito bhavati, evaṁ ca pratipadyamānaḥ samyakpratipanno bhavati |
sbh3.2:54.2: yathā aśubhāvineyo aśubhāyāṁ, tathā maitryavineyādayo api ānāpānasmṛtiparyavasānāya yathāyogaṁ veditavyāḥ |
sbh3.2:54.3: tatrāyaṁ viśeṣaḥ — tadanyeṣv avataraṇa-mukheṣu taṁ vibhāvayiṣyāmi |
sbh3.2:54.4: tatra maitrībhāvanāprayukteno ādikarmikeṇa bahirdhā mitrapakṣād udāsīnapakṣāc ca nimittam udgṛhya, pratirūpaśayanāsanagato hi sukhādhyāśayagatena manaskāreṇa samāhitabhūmikena — pūrvam ekaṁ mitram adhimoktavyam, ekam amitram, ekam udāsīnam |
sbh3.2:54.5: teṣu ca triṣu pakṣeṣu tulyaṁ hitasukhādhyāśayagatena manaskāreṇopasaṁhāraś ca karaṇīyaḥ — 'sukhitā bhavantyete sukhakāyāḥ sattvāḥ' — yad uta anavadyakāmasukhena, anavadyasaprītikasukhena, anavadyaniṣprītikasukhena |
sbh3.2:54.6: tataḥ paścād dve mitrāṇi, trīṇi, catvāri, pañca, daśa, viṁśa, triṁśat pūrvavad yāvatsarvā diśo vidiśaśca mitrāmitra-traiḥ pūrṇā adhimucyante |
sbh3.2:54.7: nirantarā yatra nāstyantaramantato daṇḍakoṭīviṣkambhanamātram api | yathā mitrapakṣeṇa evam amitrodāsīnapakṣeṇa veditavyam |
sbh3.2:54.8: sa ca maitrīprayogaṁ ca na jahāti — nānyatra bhāvayanneva maitrīṁ smṛtyupasthāneṣv avatarati |
sbh3.2:54.9: kathaṁ punaravataratyadhimucyamāno avatarati — 'yathāham apyanyeṣāṁ mitrasaṁmato, amitrasaṁmataścodāsīnasaṁmataśca | aham api sukhakāmo duḥkhapratikūlaḥ — idamasyādhyātmaṁ kāye kāyānupaśyanāyāḥ sattvam |
sbh3.2:54.10: ete api sattvāḥ pareṣāṁ mitrabhūtā, amitrabhūtā, udāsīnabhūtāśca; yathā me te api sukhakāmā duḥkhapratikūlā — idam asya bahirdhā kāyānupaśyanāyāḥ sattvam |
sbh3.2:54.11: yathāhaṁ tathaite sattvā, yathā me ātmanaḥ sukham eṣaṇīyaṁ — sattvānām ātmasamatayātmatulyatayā eṣāṁ sattvānāṁ mayābhihitasukhopasaṁhārakaraṇāya' iti — idam asyādhyātmabahirdhā kāye kāyānupaśyanāyāḥ sattvam |
sbh3.2:54.12: catvāri caitāni smṛtyupasthānāni, saṁbhinnaskandhālambanatayā saṁbhinnālambanaṁ smṛtyupasthānaṁ bhavati |
sbh3.2:54.13: rūpanimittaṁ tu yogī udgṛhya varṇasaṁsthānanimittaṁ, vijñaptinimittaṁ ca mitrāmitrodāsīnapakṣebhyo 'dhimucyate |
sbh3.2:54.14: tenedaṁ kāyasmṛtyupasthānam eva vyavasthāpyate | so 'dhimuktimanaskāraṁ niśritya bhūtamanaskāram asyāvatarati |
sbh3.2:54.15: evaṁ ca punaradhimucyamāno avatarati — 'yāvad apramāṇāḥ sattvā ete mayādhimuktā hitasukhagatenādhyāśayena | ato apramāṇatarāḥ sattvā ye mama pūrvāntam ārabhya mitrāmitrodāsīnapakṣatayā abhyatītāḥ — ye mama mitratāṁ gatvā amitratām upagatā, amitratāṁ gatvā mitratāṁ codāsīnatāṁ tu upacopagatāḥ — tadanena paryāyeṇa sarva eva sattvāḥ samasamāḥ |
sbh3.2:54.16: nāstyatra kācinmitratā vā, amitratā vodāsīnatā vā pariniṣpannā' — ityanenaiva paryāyeṇa tulya-hitasukhopasaṁhāratā ca karaṇīyā |
sbh3.2:54.17: yathā pūrvāntam ārabhya evam aparāntamapyāramya, satyāṁ saṁsṛtau saṁsāre, ye 'pi ca mayā sattvāḥ pūrvāntam ārabhya tan-maitreṇa cittenānukampitāḥ — kiñcāpi te abhyatītā api tu tān etarhyanukampe — yaduta cittaniṣkāluṣyakaluṣatām avyāpannatām upādāya |
sbh3.2:54.18: 'sukhitā bata te sattvāḥ — bhūtā bhaviṣyanti, abhūvan, ye, api ca na bhūtā anāgate adhvani sukhitā bhavantu' iti — evaṁ bhūtamanaskārānupratiṣṭhasya maitrīvihāriṇaḥ yaḥ puṇyābhiṣyandaḥ kuśalābhiṣyandaḥ — tasyādhimokṣikamaitrīvihāragataḥ puṇyaskandhaḥ śatimām api kalāṁ nopaiti | sahasrimām api | saṁkhyām api, kalām api, gaṇanām apyupaniṣadam api nopaiti | śeṣaṁ pūrvavat ||
sbh3.2:55.1: tatra idaṁpratyayatāpratītyasamutpāda-ādikarmikaḥ śrutacintādhipateyena parikalpitaṁ nimittam udgṛhṇātyanyeṣāṁ sattvānām ajñānaṁ, saṁmoho yeneme pratyakṣam anityaṁ nityato avagacchanti, pratyakṣam aśuci śucitaḥ, duḥkhaṁ sukhataḥ, nirātmakatām ātmataḥ |
sbh3.2:55.2: viparyastā ete sattvā — viparyāsa-hetor dṛṣṭe dharme, vedanāsu saṁparāye cātmabhāvābhinirvṛttau tṛṣyanti, tṛṣitāś ca jātimūlakāni karmāṇi kṛtvā evam āyatyāṁ karmakleśahetuḥ ............ kevalaṁ saṁduḥkham abhinirvartayanti —
sbh3.2:55.3: evaṁ nimittam udgṛhyādhyātmam adhimucyate: 'ayamapi kevalo duḥkhaskandha evam eva saṁbhūta' iti |
sbh3.2:55.4: ye cātmabhāvā nānantāḥ paryantāḥ pūrvāntam ārabhya yeṣām ādireva na prajñāyate, te 'pyevaṁbhūtāḥ — eṣām api sattvānām atītānāgatapratyutpannāḥ sarva evātmabhāvā duḥkhaskandhasaṁgṛhītā evam evābhinirvṛttāḥ | āyatyāṁ notpadyante |
sbh3.2:55.5: sa khalvayam idaṁpratyayatāpratītyasamutpādamanaskāraḥ sarvabhūtamanaskāra eva, nāstyādhimokṣikaḥ — yadi na punarātmano vartamānān skandhān pratītyasamutpannān manasi karoti |
sbh3.2:55.6: tadādhyātmaṁ kāye yāvad dharmeṣu dharmānudarśī viharati |
sbh3.2:55.7: yadā ca punaḥ pareṣāṁ vartamānān skandhān pratītyasamutpannān manasi karoti, tadādhyātmabahirdhā kāye yāvad dharmeṣu dharmānudarśī viharati |
sbh3.2:55.8: yadātmanaśca pareṣāṁ cātītānāgatān skandhān pratītyasamutpannān manasi karoti, tadādhyātmabahirdhā kāye yāvad dharmeṣu dharmānudarśī viharati | śeṣaṁ pūrvavat |
sbh3.2:55.9: tatra dhātuprabhedaprayogaprayukta ādikarmiko bahirdhā pṛthivīkāṭhinyanimittam udgṛhya — tadyathā bhū-parvata-tṛṇa-vana-śarkara-kaṭhilla-maṇi-mukti-vaiḍūrya-śaṅkha-śilā-pravālādikebhyaścādhyātmaṁ kāṭhinyam adhimucyate |
sbh3.2:55.10: bahirdhā apsv abdhātor nimittam udgṛhya — tadyathā nadī-prasravaṇa-taḍāga-kūpādibhyaḥ; tathā mahato agniskandhasya abdhau vā ādityakiraṇasaṁtāpitā jvarāviṣṭebhyo vā sattvebhyaḥ; udārāgnisaṁpratāpitebhyo vā prasrayebhyaḥ tathā bahirdhā vāyuskandhāt pūrvadakṣiṇa-paścimottarebhyo vāyubhyo yāvadvāyumaṇḍalebhyaḥ;
sbh3.2:55.11: ye deśā asphuṭā aspharaṇīyā vāyugatena sacchidrāḥ, suśirāḥ, sāvakāśāḥ — tasmād ākāśadhātor nimittam udgṛhṇātyadhyātmam abdhātuṁ, tejodhātuṁ, vāyudhātum, ākāśadhātum adhimucyate, śrutacintādhipateyena ca parikalpitena |
sbh3.2:55.12: evaṁ vijñānadhātor nimittam udgṛhṇāti — cakṣur ādhyātmikam āyatanam aparibhinnaṁ cedbhavati, rūpam ābhāsagataṁ, na ca tajjo manaskāraḥ pratyupasthito bhavati, na tajjasya cakṣurvijñānasya prādurbhāvo bhavati — viparyayād bhavati | evaṁ yāvanmanodharmān manovijñānaṁ veditavyam |
sbh3.2:55.13: evaṁ nimittam udgṛhyāstyeṣāṁ sarveṣāṁ vijñānānām asmin kāye cāturmahābhūtike bījaṁ, dhātur, gotraṁ, prakṛtir ityadhimucyate |
sbh3.2:55.14: tānyetāni catvāri mahābhūtāni tatprathamato aṅgapratyaṅgaudārikāṇy adhimucyate; tataḥ paścāt sūkṣmatarāvayava-prabhedān adhimucyate; evaṁ yāvad vātāyanapraviṣṭatruṭi-samatayā; evaṁ yāvac chanaiḥ śanaiḥ paramāṇuśo 'dhimucyate |
sbh3.2:55.15: sa ekaikam aṅgāvayavapramāṇa-paramāṇu-saṁcaya-sanniviṣṭam adhimucyate; kaḥ punarvādaḥ sarvakāyamayam |
sbh3.2:55.16: ayaṁ dhātuprabhedaprayuktasya dhātuprabhedaparyanto rūpiṇāṁ tāvad-dhātūnām, ākāśadhātoḥ punaḥ — yatpunarasya tasmin prayoge śamathavipaśyanābhāvanāyāṁ vikṣepāvikṣepaparijñāvadhānam — idam asya saṁprajanyasya smṛtisamatāyāś ca |
sbh3.2:56.1: yatpunaḥ saṁveganimittaṁ, prasadanīyaṁ ca nimittaṁ sūdgṛhītaṁ bhavati — idam asyābhidhyādaurmanasya-vinayasya |
sbh3.2:56.2: tasyaivam ātāpino viharato yāvad dvitīyaloke abhidhyādaurmanasyaṁ pūrvam eva samyakprayogasamārambhakāle |
sbh3.2:56.3: sūkṣmacittapraśrabdhir durupalakṣyā pravarttate — yā tatra śamathamvā bhāvayato, vipaśyanāmvā prasvasthacittatā, prasvasthakāyatā, cittakāyakarmaṇyatā | iyam atra kāyacittapraśrabdhiḥ |
sbh3.2:56.4: tasya saiva sūkṣmā cittaikāgratā cittakāyapraśrabdhiścābhivardhamānā audārikāṁ sūpalakṣyāṁ cittaikāgratāṁ kāyapraśrabdhim āvahati — yad uta hetupāraṁparyādānayogena |
sbh3.2:56.5: na tasya, na cirasyedānīm audārikī cittakāyapraśrabdhiścittaikāgratā ca sūpalakṣyotpatsyatīti — yāvad asyāḥ pūrvanimittaṁ mūrdhani gaurava-pratibhāsam utpadyate — na caitad bādhalakṣaṇam |
sbh3.2:56.6: tasyānantarotpādād yat prahāṇaratir-vibandhakāri-kleśapakṣyaṁ cittadauṣṭhulyaṁ tat prahīyate, tatpratipakṣeṇa ca cittakarmaṇyatā cittapraśrabdhir utpadyate |
sbh3.2:56.7: tasyotpādāt kāyapraśrabdhyutpādānukūlāni vāyūdriktāni mahābhūtāni kāye 'vakramanti | teṣām avakramaṇahetoryat kāyadauṣṭhulyaṁ tad vigacchati |
sbh3.2:56.8: prahāṇarativibandhakarakleśapakṣyaṁ kāyapraśrabdhyā ca tatpratipakṣikayā sarvakāyaḥ pūryate | sphuṭa iva khyāti |
sbh3.2:56.9: tataḥ prathamopanipāte cittaudvilyaṁ ca cittasumanaskatā prāmodyasahagatālambanasābhirāmatā ca cittasya tasmin samaye khyāti |
sbh3.2:56.10: tasyordhvaṁ yo 'sau tatprathamopanipātī praśrabdhivegaḥ — sa śanaiḥ śanaiḥ pariślathataro bhavati |
sbh3.2:56.11: chāyevānugatā praśrabdhiḥ kāye ca pravarttate | yac ca tad audvilyaṁ cetasas tad apyavahīyate |
sbh3.2:56.13: tata ūrdhvam ayaṁ yogī ādikarmikaḥ *samanaskāro* bhavati — '*samanaskāra*' iti ca saṁkhyāṁ gacchati |
sbh3.2:56.14: tatkasya hetoḥ — rūpāvacaro 'nena samāhitabhūmiko manaskāraḥ parīttastaprathamataḥ pratilabdho bhavati | tenocyate *samanaskāra* iti |
sbh3.2:56.15: tasyāsya *samanaskārasya* ādikarmikasyemāni liṅgāni bhavanti — parīttam anena rūpāvacaraṁ cittaṁ pratilabdhaṁ bhavati |
sbh3.2:56.16: parīttā kāyapraśrabdhiś cittapraśrabdhiś cittaikāgratā — bhavyo bhavati pratibalaḥ |
sbh3.2:56.17: kleśaviśodhanālambanaḥ prayogasya, snigdhā cāsya cittasantatiḥ pravarttate | śamathopagūḍhāccaritaṁ tadānena viśodhitaṁ bhavati |
sbh3.2:56.18: sa cedrañjanīye viṣaye carati — na tīvraṁ rāgaparyavasthānam utpādayati | alpamātrakeṇāvaramātrakeṇa ca, pratipakṣasanniśrayeṇa ābhogamātrakeṇa śaknoti prativinodayituṁ |
sbh3.2:56.19: yathā rañjanīye, evaṁ dveṣanīye, mohanīye, mānasthānīye, vitarkasthānīye veditavyam |
sbh3.2:56.20: niṣaṇṇasya cāsya pratisaṁlayane cittaṁ pratidadhatas tvaritatvaritaṁ cittaṁ praśrabhyate, kāyaśca |
sbh3.2:56.21: kāyadauṣṭhulyāni ca nātyarthaṁ bādhante | na cātyarthaṁ nivaraṇasamudācāro bhavati | na cātyarthamutkaṇṭhā-ratiparitamanāsahagatāḥ saṁjñāmanasikārāḥ samudācaranti |
sbh3.2:56.22: vyutthitasyāpi manaso 'pi carataḥ — praśrabdhi-mātrā kācic citte, kāye, citte cānugatā bhavati ityevaṁbhāgīyāni *samanaskārasya* ādikarmikasya liṅgāni nimittānyavadātāni veditavyāni ||
